hotspots.title: Bullrich’s rebellion against Javier Milei
hotspots.blurb: Patricia Bullrich, Argentina's Security Minister, has openly defied President Javier Milei by opposing the appointment of Judge María Verónica Michelli. This internal conflict within La Libertad Avanza has escalated tensions, with Bullrich threatening to resign and challenging the government's judicial strategy.
hotspots.affect: This rebellion commands attention due to the high-stakes power struggle within the ruling coalition, threatening its stability and future electoral prospects.

hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism classification in Hesse
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party faces intensified scrutiny and potential extremism classification in Hesse, Germany. This follows a series of controversial statements and actions by party leaders, including comparisons to historical extremist movements and inflammatory rhetoric on migration and nationalism.
hotspots.affect: The classification debate has sparked national outrage and polarized political discourse, with accusations of democratic backsliding and far-right normalization.

hotspots.title: Vannacci’s Futuro Nazionale gains momentum
hotspots.blurb: Roberto Vannacci, a former Italian general, has rapidly expanded his new political party, Futuro Nazionale, by recruiting defectors from Lega and Forza Italia. The party's rise reflects growing dissatisfaction with traditional right-wing parties and a shift toward more radical policies.
hotspots.affect: Vannacci’s party has become a focal point for far-right consolidation, drawing intense media scrutiny and sparking fears of further fragmentation within Italy’s political landscape.

hotspots.affect: The event has become a lightning rod for debates over political polarization, security concerns, and the intersection of sports and politics in America.

hotspots.title: Magyar Péter’s EU migration pact protests
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar faces massive protests over his government’s decision to comply with the EU Migration Pact. Demonstrators accuse him of betraying national sovereignty and caving to Brussels’ demands, while the government defends the move as necessary for securing EU funds.
hotspots.affect: The protests have galvanized opposition groups and far-right factions, creating a charged atmosphere of nationalistic grievance and anti-EU sentiment.
